import outputs.Algorithms.Muon
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Star.Real
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.SpecialFunctions.Inner
open MeasureTheory Matrix Filter Topology
namespace OracleTemplate.Muon
variable {m n : ℕ}

section Abstract
variable (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (lam c : Fin n → ℝ)

theorem frob_eq_trace (X : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ∑ p, ∑ q, A p q * X p q = (Aᵀ * X).trace := by sorry

theorem gram_diag (hVV : Vᵀ * V = 1) (hAV : Aᵀ * A * V = V * diagonal lam) :
    (A * V)ᵀ * (A * V) = diagonal lam := by sorry

theorem trace_orth (hVV : Vᵀ * V = 1) (hAV : Aᵀ * A * V = V * diagonal lam) :
    (Aᵀ * (A * V * diagonal c * Vᵀ)).trace = ∑ i, lam i * c i := by sorry

theorem trace_orth_sq (hVV : Vᵀ * V = 1) (hAV : Aᵀ * A * V = V * diagonal lam) :
    ((A * V * diagonal c * Vᵀ)ᵀ * (A * V * diagonal c * Vᵀ)).trace = ∑ i, c i ^ 2 * lam i := by sorry

theorem orth_mulVec_sq (hVV : Vᵀ * V = 1) (hAV : Aᵀ * A * V = V * diagonal lam) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ((A * V * diagonal c * Vᵀ) *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((A * V * diagonal c * Vᵀ) *ᵥ x) =
      ∑ i, c i ^ 2 * lam i * (Vᵀ *ᵥ x) i ^ 2 := by sorry

theorem parseval (hVV' : V * Vᵀ = 1) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (Vᵀ *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Vᵀ *ᵥ x) = x ⬝ᵥ x := by sorry

end Abstract
theorem norm_toLp_sq (w : Fin n → ℝ) : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))‖ ^ 2 = w ⬝ᵥ w := by sorry

theorem mulVec_dot_le (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (u : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (M *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ u) ≤
      ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toEuclideanLin M)‖ ^ 2 * (u ⬝ᵥ u) := by sorry

theorem dot_le_sqrt (u w : Fin n → ℝ) : u ⬝ᵥ w ≤ Real.sqrt (u ⬝ᵥ u) * Real.sqrt (w ⬝ᵥ w) := by sorry

theorem inner_mat_trace (A X : Mat m n) : inner ℝ A X = ((toMatrix A)ᵀ * toMatrix X).trace := by sorry

theorem unitary_data (W : Mat m n) :
    let V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ :=
      ((Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (toMatrix W)).eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    Vᵀ * V = 1 ∧ V * Vᵀ = 1 ∧ (toMatrix W)ᵀ * toMatrix W * V = V * diagonal (gramEigenvalues W) ∧
      ∀ q i, V q i = (rightSingularVectors W i) q := by sorry

theorem toMatrix_ofMatrix (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) : toMatrix (ofMatrix M) = M := by sorry

theorem toMatrix_orthogonalize (W : Mat m n) :
    let V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ :=
      ((Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (toMatrix W)).eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    toMatrix (orthogonalize W) = toMatrix W * V *
      diagonal (fun i => if 0 < singularValues W i then (singularValues W i)⁻¹ else 0) * Vᵀ := by sorry

theorem coef_mul_eig (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (if 0 < Real.sqrt x then (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹ else 0) * x = Real.sqrt x := by sorry

theorem coef_sq_mul_eig (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (if 0 < Real.sqrt x then (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹ else 0) ^ 2 * x = if 0 < x then 1 else 0 := by sorry

theorem inner_orthogonalize (W : Mat m n) : inner ℝ W (orthogonalize W) = nuclearNorm W := by sorry

theorem norm_orthogonalize_sq (W : Mat m n) :
    ‖orthogonalize W‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, if 0 < gramEigenvalues W i then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by sorry

theorem count_pos_le_m (W : Mat m n) :
    (∑ i, if 0 < gramEigenvalues W i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ m := by sorry

theorem count_pos_le_n (W : Mat m n) :
    (∑ i, if 0 < gramEigenvalues W i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ n := by sorry

theorem norm_orthogonalize_sq_le (W : Mat m n) : ‖orthogonalize W‖ ^ 2 ≤ (min m n : ℕ) := by sorry

theorem spectralNorm_orthogonalize_le (W : Mat m n) : spectralNorm (orthogonalize W) ≤ 1 := by sorry

theorem singularValues_nonneg (W : Mat m n) (i : Fin n) : 0 ≤ singularValues W i := by sorry

theorem nuclearNorm_nonneg (W : Mat m n) : 0 ≤ nuclearNorm W := by sorry

theorem spectralNorm_nonneg (X : Mat m n) : 0 ≤ spectralNorm X := by sorry

theorem inner_le_nuclearNorm_mul_spectralNorm (A X : Mat m n) :
    inner ℝ A X ≤ nuclearNorm A * spectralNorm X := by sorry

theorem nuclearNorm_le_sqrt_mul_norm (A : Mat m n) :
    nuclearNorm A ≤ Real.sqrt (min m n : ℕ) * ‖A‖ := by sorry

theorem nuclearNorm_le_add_inner (A B : Mat m n) :
    nuclearNorm (A + B) ≤ nuclearNorm A + nuclearNorm B := by sorry

theorem toMatrix_smul (c : ℝ) (X : Mat m n) : toMatrix (c • X) = c • toMatrix X := by sorry

theorem spectralNorm_smul (c : ℝ) (X : Mat m n) : spectralNorm (c • X) = |c| * spectralNorm X := by sorry

theorem abs_inner_le_nuclearNorm_mul_spectralNorm (A X : Mat m n) :
    |inner ℝ A X| ≤ nuclearNorm A * spectralNorm X := by sorry

theorem nuclearNorm_smul_le (c : ℝ) (A : Mat m n) : nuclearNorm (c • A) ≤ |c| * nuclearNorm A := by sorry

theorem nuclearNorm_sub_le (A B : Mat m n) : nuclearNorm (A - B) ≤ nuclearNorm A + nuclearNorm B := by sorry

theorem nuclearNorm_sub_comm_le (A B : Mat m n) : nuclearNorm (A - B) ≤ nuclearNorm (B - A) := by sorry

theorem orthogonalize_eq_of_svd (W : Mat m n) {k : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (s : Fin k → ℝ) (hU : Uᵀ * U = 1) (hV : Vᵀ * V = 1)
    (hs : ∀ l, 0 < s l) (hW : toMatrix W = U * diagonal s * Vᵀ) :
    toMatrix (orthogonalize W) = U * Vᵀ := by sorry

theorem nuclearNorm_eq_of_svd (W : Mat m n) {k : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (s : Fin k → ℝ) (hU : Uᵀ * U = 1) (hV : Vᵀ * V = 1)
    (hs : ∀ l, 0 < s l) (hW : toMatrix W = U * diagonal s * Vᵀ) :
    nuclearNorm W = ∑ l, s l := by sorry

theorem newton_scalar_tendsto (x : ℝ) (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (fun t : ℝ => t * (3 - x * t ^ 2) / 2)^[k] 1) atTop (𝓝 (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) := by sorry

theorem continuous_toMatrix : Continuous (toMatrix : Mat m n → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) := by sorry

theorem continuous_ofMatrix : Continuous (ofMatrix : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ → Mat m n) := by sorry

theorem conj_mul_conj (E X Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hEE : Eᵀ * E = 1) :
    (E * X * Eᵀ) * (E * Z * Eᵀ) = E * (X * Z) * Eᵀ := by sorry

theorem newton_matrix_eq (E : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (d : Fin n → ℝ) (hEE : Eᵀ * E = 1)
    (hEE' : E * Eᵀ = 1) (k : ℕ) :
    (fun Y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (Y * ((3 : ℝ) • 1 - (E * diagonal d * Eᵀ) * Y * Y)))^[k] 1 =
      E * diagonal (fun i => (fun t : ℝ => t * (3 - d i * t ^ 2) / 2)^[k] 1) * Eᵀ := by sorry

theorem entry_conj_diag (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (E : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (d : Fin n → ℝ)
    (p : Fin m) (q : Fin n) : (M * diagonal d * Eᵀ) p q = ∑ i, M p i * d i * E q i := by sorry

theorem gram_entry_sq (W : Mat m n) (i : Fin n) :
    let E : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ :=
      ((Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (toMatrix W)).eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    ∑ p, (toMatrix W * E) p i * (toMatrix W * E) p i = gramEigenvalues W i := by sorry

theorem gramEigenvalues_le (W : Mat m n) (i : Fin n) : gramEigenvalues W i ≤ ‖W‖ ^ 2 := by sorry

theorem measurable_orthogonalize : Measurable (orthogonalize : Mat m n → Mat m n) := by sorry

theorem measurable_nuclearNorm : Measurable (nuclearNorm : Mat m n → ℝ) := by sorry

end OracleTemplate.Muon
